scope_rules: Every nested typed reference has the outer tenant; IDs never grant access.
ExecutionContext is constructed only through a trusted server HostAuthorization port after authentication/session/purpose checks. No from-array constructor.
Owners recheck current authorization, consent and emergency policy at write/disclosure; pins do not grant rights.
Unknown cannot become failed/completed/cancelled without trusted resolution evidence.
UTC timestamps use Z, valid calendar dates, no implicit current clock; normalize trailing fractional zeros.

canonical_hash.canonicalization: existing RFC 8785 JCS through CanonicalJson port
canonical_hash.transport_timestamps: Not accepted in the stable source payload schema.
canonical_hash.numeric_rule: Cross-language integers are bounded to 2^53-1; no float IDs/versions.

proposal_identity: Persist provider proposal ID or normalized ordinal once; never regenerate on retry.
effect_identity: Keep dated Action/effect IDs and persisted owner operation ref; effect_key is tenant/action/ordinal bound.
limitations: Value/schema contracts and pure reducers only; no store, transaction, effect execution, runtime loop or external owner implementation.
Full immutable profile publication and all IO adapters remain their owning tasks.
No change to dated ActionStatus, existing SDK key derivations or PHP/Dart API.
